item.title: 0.82.0-beta.3
item.description:
# What's New in TablePro 0.82.0-beta.3
### Added
- New UUID in a UUID primary key the server does not fill, on Add Row, Duplicate Row and Paste. ([#3446](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3446)) - Edit > Set Value in the menu bar, with rows in Settings > Keyboard. ([#3446](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3446)) - Generate UUID and Generate UUIDv7 in Set Value, the row inspector and Fill Column, a new value for each cell. ([#3446](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3446)) - Theme Editor window with a live preview, undo and Revert Changes. Open windows show each edit as you make it. ([#3452](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3452)) - Theme import by dropping files on the Themes list, and export by dragging a theme to Finder. ([#3452](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3452)) - VS Code color theme import in Settings > Appearance, from the theme's `.json` file. ([#3452](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3452)) - iCloud sync of custom themes and the chosen light and dark themes, with Settings on in Settings > Sync. ([#3452](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3452)) - Solarized, GitHub, Catppuccin, Gruvbox and Tokyo Night themes in light and dark, plus One Dark and One Light. ([#3452](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3452)) - Get beta updates in Settings > General, from a signed update feed at updates.tablepro.app. ([#3501](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3501)) - Drag the line beside the connections strip to widen it and read long connection and database names. ([#3526](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3526))
### Changed
- UUID functions in SQL Functions replaced by Generate UUID, which writes the value itself. ([#3446](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3446)) - PluginKit ABI 39, additive: existing plugins keep loading. ([#3446](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3446)) - Text typed into a column that is not a date or time saved as typed, even when it reads like `now()`. ([#3446](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3446)) - Set Value applies to every selected cell, or to the clicked column across the selected rows. ([#3446](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3446)) - Set NULL and Set DEFAULT in the row inspector shown only where the column takes them, as in the data grid. ([#3446](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3446)) - Default only on new rows on SQLite, libSQL, Turso, D1, ClickHouse, Databend, Snowflake, Trino, Cassandra. ([#3446](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3446)) - SQL functions in Set Value and the row inspector listed per database and only where they fit the column. ([#3446](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3446)) - Pending SQL functions in the data grid drawn like a pending default. ([#3446](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3446)) - SQL aliases and parameters drawn in the editor text color instead of the NULL color. ([#3452](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3452)) - SQL previews in history, filters, maintenance and review sheets highlighted as in the editor, in the editor font. ([#3452](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3452)) - Editor tab strip over a themed window on macOS 26 and later drawn in a system fill instead of the theme color. ([#3452](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3452)) - Server Dashboard sessions and slow queries shown as data grids, with Cancel Query and Terminate Session in the header. ([#3452](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3452)) - Data Files, Compare & Sync and Open in Window value windows show the theme in the titlebar on macOS 26 and later. ([#3452](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3452)) - Terminate Session and Cancel Query confirmations name the session's process ID and user. ([#3452](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3452)) - Appearance (System, Light or Dark) kept per Mac instead of syncing. Older versions that sync settings switch to System. ([#3452](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3452)) - Compare & Sync status bar shows the target connection's icon instead of a colored dot. ([#3452](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3452)) - Themes move to the Trash instead of being deleted. Undo reverts a trash, rename, duplicate or import. ([#3452](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3452)) - Plugin download progress shown as the bytes arrive instead of jumping to full at the end. ([#3491](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3491)) - Welcome window and What's New show the build number after the version. ([#3497](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3497)) - Registry drivers such as Oracle, SQL Server and MongoDB load on first use instead of at launch. ([#3502](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3502)) - Registry plugins update after a TablePro update, not from an Update button; a loaded one updates at the next launch. ([#3507](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3507))
### Removed
- The `com.TablePro.customRegistryURL` setting for a custom plugin registry. ([#3515](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3515))
### Fixed
- ClickHouse SQL export writing the current database's table structure for a table in another database. ([#3445](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3445)) - SQL Server 2016 RTM offered a `CREATE OR ALTER VIEW` template it cannot run, and Azure SQL a drop-and-create one. ([#3445](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3445)) - A ClickHouse query that failed partway showing its partial rows and the error text as a row instead of the error. ([#3445](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3445)) - Opening a ClickHouse executable function's definition showing a syntax error. ([#3445](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3445)) - Every ClickHouse query after connecting failing with `UNKNOWN_SETTING` on 23.8.0 to 23.8.8. ([#3445](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3445)) - ClickHouse users with a read-only profile unable to connect. ([#3445](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3445)) - A ClickHouse query with a `FORMAT` clause showing garbled rows in the grid and in an export. ([#3445](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3445)) - ClickHouse indexes, view definitions, functions, table comments and sizes failing to load on servers before 22.3. ([#3445](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3445)) - Default on a saved row failing on SQLite, and storing `__DEFAULT__` on Teradata and DynamoDB. ([#3446](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3446)) - Stored text such as `CURRENT_DATE` turning into today's date on Duplicate Row or Restore Previous Values. ([#3446](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3446)) - Empty field in the multi-row inspector after the selected rows were given different values. ([#3446](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3446)) - Duplicate Row and Paste failing to save on a UUID primary key with no default. ([#3446](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3446)) - `gen_random_uuid()`, `UUID()`, `NEWID()` and `datetime('now')` from SQL Functions saved as quoted text. ([#3446](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3446)) - Date functions and a date picker offered on Cassandra and ScyllaDB `timeuuid` columns. ([#3446](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3446)) - SQL functions saved as text on SQL Server, Teradata, Spanner and BigQuery. ([#3446](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3446)) - MariaDB `uuid` columns read as `CHAR`. ([#3446](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3446)) - SQLite's `datetime('now')` offered on DuckDB and `gen_random_uuid()` on Redshift. ([#3446](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3446)) - Copy as INSERT and Copy as UPDATE quoting a staged SQL function. ([#3446](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3446)) - `NOW()` offered on SQLite, Oracle, Cassandra and MongoDB, where it fails or saves the text. ([#3446](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3446)) - Server Dashboard lists and the Query Insights chart ignoring the theme. ([#3452](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3452)) - Changes to a theme file made outside TablePro not shown until Settings > Appearance was opened. ([#3452](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3452)) - Shapes in the result Map view keeping the previous Accent color after it changes. ([#3452](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3452)) - Agent result states and proposed SQL ignoring the theme. ([#3452](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3452)) - Selected text in SQL previews, such as query history, ignoring the theme's selection color. ([#3452](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3452)) - Theme editor bringing back a theme file deleted in Finder on the next change. ([#3452](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3452)) - Structure and Create Table code placeholders, Startup SQL in a link and the tunnel command preview ignoring the theme. ([#3452](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3452)) - Inline cell editor, the array editor's Edit as Text, and the inspector's hex dump and map pane ignoring the theme. ([#3452](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3452)) - Compare & Sync row states and Data Files loading and failure states drawn without the theme's grid background. ([#3452](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3452)) - Translucent theme selection, as in Dracula and Nord, in a different shade on rows, row numbers and column headers. ([#3452](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3452)) - No outline around a selected cell range in Dracula and Nord. ([#3452](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3452)) - No-match, invalid and NULL states in the JSON, PHP and array viewers drawn without the theme's background. ([#3452](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3452)) - System-colored alternate rows, header and booleans in a theme that sets only the grid background and text. ([#3452](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3452)) - System header band on the data grid and the Query Plan and Users & Roles trees under a theme with header colors. ([#3452](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3452)) - Bars in query, history, filter, structure, plan, compare and other panes drawing a system band over a themed window. ([#3452](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3452)) - Two themes with the same name impossible to tell apart in the theme pickers. ([#3452](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3452)) - Connecting and Not connected panes, and Agent mode, in the system window color under a theme before macOS 26. ([#3452](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3452)) - Selected row text in white over a theme's selection color, or in the theme's color over the system selection. ([#3452](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3452)) - Theme files with a JSON syntax error reported without the line and column. ([#3452](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3452)) - Edit as Text in the array editor turning straight quotes and dashes into curly quotes and long dashes. ([#3452](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3452)) - No warning on a connection in the Welcome window whose driver plugin failed to load or is out of date. ([#3478](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3478)) - Snowflake, Kafka and GitHub Copilot saw every TablePro build as version 1.0.0. ([#3517](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3517)) - Object browser squeezed below its minimum width after the connections strip slid in. ([#3526](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3526))
### Security
- SAP HANA plugin 1.0.1 to 1.0.3 shipping a helper built with Go 1.27.1, without the crypto/tls fix for GO-2026-6607. ([#3513](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/3513))
[View release notes](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/releases/tag/v0.82.0-beta.3)

# What's New in TablePro 0.81.0
Cloud Firestore, Firebase Realtime Database and Google Cloud Bigtable connect through new registry plugins.
Each database in the connections strip keeps its own tabs, and Oracle query tabs get a schema picker.
Themes color every content view and the window background. Themes made for earlier versions need to be recreated.
Plugins signed by other developers stop loading, and HTML and XML export are removed.
[View full changelog](https://docs.tablepro.app/changelog)

# What's New in TablePro 0.81.0

Each database in the connections strip keeps its own tabs, and Oracle query tabs get a schema picker.
Themes color every content view and the window background. Themes made for earlier versions need to be recreated.
Plugins signed by other developers stop loading, and HTML and XML export are removed.
[View full changelog](https://docs.tablepro.app/changelog)

# What's New in TablePro 0.80.0
Google Cloud IAM sign-in for MySQL and PostgreSQL on Cloud SQL, with no Cloud SQL Auth Proxy.
MySQL and MariaDB connect through a local Unix socket.
A geometry value opens on a map in the row inspector, and the status bar shows Sum, Average and Count of the selected cells.
Connections and groups take custom icons. Connection exports carry saved queries and open only in 0.80.0 or later.
[View full changelog](https://docs.tablepro.app/changelog)

[View full changelog](https://docs.tablepro.app/changelog)

# What's New in TablePro 0.79.0
SSH tunnel, Cloudflare Tunnel and SOCKS proxy for Weaviate, Typesense and Elasticsearch.
An Elasticsearch connection takes several nodes and moves to the next when one stops answering.
MySQL 4.1 to 5.1 servers list and open their tables.
MongoDB, Redis, etcd and SAP HANA reads run at Read-Only and skip the Alert prompt.
[View full changelog](https://docs.tablepro.app/changelog)
